seo.title: Sazid — Senior Full-Stack Engineer
seo.description: Sazid is a Senior Full-Stack Engineer at Design Monks, Dhaka. 5+ years and 80+ projects engineering Next.js web applications, Node.js microservices, PostgreSQL databases and resilient cloud architectures.
seo.shareDescription: 5+ years and 80+ projects engineering Next.js web applications, Node.js microservices and distributed cloud systems. Now at Design Monks.

hero.tagline: Full-Stack Software Engineer building scalable cloud architectures, high-performance web applications, and resilient distributed systems with 120 FPS creative engineering.

work.d: Real-time tournament command center featuring live match stats, dynamic fixtures, group standings, interactive bracket predictor, and high-concurrency editorial updates.

dossier.topology: [Sports Radar API] -> [Node.js WebSocket Cluster] -> [Redis Pub/Sub Sync] -> [Next.js SSR Client Engine]
dossier.challenge: Live international tournament traffic causes unpredictable, volatile spikes with tens of thousands of concurrent requests per second hitting live score and commentary widgets during critical match minutes.
dossier.solution: Architected an event-driven edge stream utilizing Redis Pub/Sub connected to Next.js lightweight client subscribers, offloading match data from core relational databases and achieving instantaneous score updates without client reloads.
decisions: Sub-Second Event Streaming: SSE/WebSocket pipeline pushing live score updates, goal alerts, and disciplinary events directly to active viewports.
Dynamic Visual Bracket: Interactive SVG tournament knockout tree calculating conditional qualification pathways in real-time on client side.
Edge Micro-Caching: 5-second TTL stale-while-revalidate edge cache ensuring zero backend degradation during peak penalty shootouts.

work.d: High-throughput continuous news dispatch engine delivering chronological reverse-time feeds, live ticker alerts, and instant editorial publication.

dossier.topology: [Journalist CMS Desk] -> [On-Demand ISR Webhook] -> [Varnish Edge Caching] -> [Next.js Dynamic View]
dossier.challenge: During major national breaking news events, millions of readers refresh the latest news feed simultaneously, risking cache stampedes and server collapse while demanding up-to-the-second reporting.
dossier.solution: Engineered an On-Demand Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) pipeline triggered via editorial webhooks, coupled with optimistic UI client rendering to guarantee sub-35ms reads directly from edge cache.
decisions: Webhook Cache Invalidation: Targeted tagging cache purges that update only affected category lists in < 100ms across nationwide edge servers.
Virtualized Infinite Pagination: Windowed infinite scrolling preventing DOM node bloat and memory leaks on long browsing sessions.
High-Throughput Read Replica: Segregated read/write database routing shielding editorial publication APIs from read traffic surges.

work.d: Robust historical archive search and multi-edition filter system enabling readers to navigate print paper editions, date-specific manifests, and categorized news history.

dossier.topology: [Multi-Edition Metadata] -> [Elasticsearch Cluster] -> [FastAPI / Node Indexer] -> [Next.js SSR Reader]
dossier.challenge: Querying millions of archived articles across regional editions (Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, etc.) with multi-parameter date and category filters led to slow table scans and high database memory pressure.
dossier.solution: Implemented compound indexing and Elasticsearch faceted search with an immutable date-based Redis caching tier, reducing complex historical query times from 2.4s to under 45ms.
decisions: Immutable Date Caching: Past edition records cached permanently with infinite HTTP cache-control, achieving a 99.4% cache hit ratio.
Faceted Query Optimizer: Client-side URL state synchronization reflecting selected date, edition, and category with zero layout shift.
Bengali Script Full-Text Search: Custom tokenizer and stemming analyzer ensuring accurate search matches across Bengali Unicode text.

work.d: Comprehensive interactive weather portal delivering hyper-local 64-district forecasts, live radar, air quality indexing (AQI), and agricultural weather advisories across Bangladesh.

dossier.topology: [BMD & OpenWeather APIs] -> [Aggregator & Validator Cron] -> [Redis Spatial Cache] -> [Interactive Vector Map]
dossier.challenge: Third-party meteorological API rate limits and high latency made live client-side fetching prohibitive, while rendering interactive district-level weather maps caused mobile frame drops.
dossier.solution: Constructed a server-side ingestion worker that polls, validates, and normalizes meteorological data every 10 minutes into an in-memory geo-indexed cache, serving lightweight SVG vector maps with zero client overhead.
decisions: Geo-IP Auto Detection: Automatically detects reader's division/district to surface instant local temperature, humidity, and rain alerts.
Hardware-Accelerated Vector Map: Custom optimized SVG map of Bangladesh supporting 60 FPS interactive hover tooltips and heat-map overlays.
Weather Advisory Alerting: Automated banner trigger for cyclone warnings, heatwaves, and monsoon flood advisories.

work.d: Mission-critical election night tracking portal with live constituency seat maps, real-time vote count visualizers, party tally progress bars, and high-frequency analytical breakdown.

dossier.topology: [EC Field Reporting Desk] -> [Validated Election Ingest Queue] -> [Redis Cluster State] -> [Edge CDN SSE Fan-Out]
dossier.challenge: Election night generates the highest peak traffic in news media history, with millions of concurrent users intensely polling constituency seat results, creating catastrophic crash risks on standard server backends.
dossier.solution: Architected a decoupled, read-only static JSON state architecture distributed across global edge CDN nodes with Server-Sent Events (SSE) delta fan-out, ensuring zero database queries on user traffic during peak election moments.
decisions: Zero-DB User Reads: User viewports consume pre-computed edge-cached JSON snapshots updated every 15 seconds by a hardened backend pipeline.
300-Constituency Vector Map: Interactive D3.js vector map of Bangladesh coloring parliamentary seats live as results are declared.
Graceful Degradation Strategy: Automated failover to cached static fallback pages if upstream networks experience carrier-level disconnections.

work.d: Modern high-traffic digital news publication platform featuring custom drag-and-drop page section builders, role-based editorial workflows, and automated media delivery pipelines.

dossier.topology: [Admin Section Builder] -> [Sequelize ORM & MySQL Layer] -> [Express API Gateway] -> [Next.js App Router SSR Engine]
dossier.challenge: Migrating a legacy decoupled Vite/Express portal to a unified Next.js 15 App Router architecture without database schema regression, while empowering non-technical editors to dynamically reorder homepage sections, hero banners, and ad units in real-time.
dossier.solution: Engineered a unified hybrid architecture orchestrating an Express custom server with Next.js 15 App Router, coupled with a modular dnd-kit visual section builder and Sharp-accelerated WebP transformation pipeline delivering sub-50ms SSR page loads.
decisions: Dynamic Section Layout Engine: dnd-kit visual composer persisting customized section orders, category rows, and ad slots directly into MySQL JSON layouts.
Unified Express-Next Hybrid: Custom server handling raw file uploads and RESTful API endpoints natively while streaming Next.js React 19 pages with zero proxy overhead.
Sharp Image Optimization Pipeline: On-the-fly multi-resolution WebP compression reducing mobile bandwidth consumption by 65% across regional 3G/4G networks.

work.d: Fast-loading headless e-commerce storefront featuring dynamic catalog filtering, hydration-safe reactive shopping bag state, and end-to-end checkout validation.

dossier.topology: [REST Catalog API] -> [Next.js App Router Server Actions] -> [Hydration-Safe Global Store] -> [Client UI & Checkout Engine]
dossier.challenge: Standard client-rendered e-commerce sites suffer from poor initial product indexing, noticeable Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) during price computations, and hydration mismatches when synchronizing localStorage cart state with server-rendered DOM.
dossier.solution: Architected a Next.js App Router headless storefront featuring dynamic `generateMetadata` for deep product SEO, streaming suspense skeletons for zero-CLS layout stability, and a two-phase hydration-guarded reducer preventing client/server markup divergence.
decisions: Hydration-Safe State Machine: Custom React Context + AppReducer architecture decoupling server markup from client localStorage persistence without visual flicker.
Dynamic Product SEO Engine: Server-side `generateMetadata` generating canonical OpenGraph tags and JSON-LD structured product cards dynamically.
Multi-Factor Filter Engine: Zero-delay client-side category indexing, search ranking, and price range filters with optimized micro-memoization.

work.d: Interactive high-fidelity product prototype demonstrating transformer-based unstructured data ingestion, real-time extraction pipelines, and advanced 3D WebGL data telemetry.

dossier.topology: [Raw Document Ingestion] -> [Transformer Extraction Pipeline] -> [No-Re-Render Ref Bridge] -> [React Three Fiber WebGL Canvas]
dossier.challenge: Synchronizing complex scroll timelines with high-poly 3D WebGL particle simulations in React typically triggers continuous component re-renders, dropping framerates well below 30 FPS on high-refresh-rate displays.
dossier.solution: Engineered a "No-Re-Render Bridge" leveraging Framer Motion `MotionValue` subscribed directly to mutable `useRef` buffers consumed inside React Three Fiber's native `useFrame` loop, bypassing the React Virtual DOM to sustain a locked 60 FPS.
decisions: Zero-VirtualDOM 3D Bridge: Mutable reference buffer passing scroll progress directly into WebGL vertex shaders without triggering React render passes.
Dual-Engine Motion Pipeline: GSAP ScrollTrigger orchestrating SVG pipeline connector paths alongside Framer Motion Spring physics for UI overlays.
SSR-Isolated Canvas Loading: Next.js dynamic client boundary imports preventing server hydration failures while maintaining zero initial JS blocking.

work.d: Luxury real estate portal and property management platform showcasing premier architectural developments, location-based property mapping, and instant buyer inquiry pipelines.

dossier.topology: [Admin Property CMS] -> [MySQL Pooled Database] -> [Express Controller API] -> [Next.js SSR Showcase Engine]
dossier.challenge: High-resolution architectural photography, panoramic virtual tour assets, and complex multi-parameter location filtering (commercial, residential, square footage, handover status) caused heavy mobile bandwidth drain and initial layout shift.
dossier.solution: Built a unified Next.js SSR portal integrated with an Express/MySQL backend featuring connection-pooled query optimization, automated Sharp image WebP conversion, and responsive layout primitives delivering instantaneous property discovery.
decisions: Relational Property Indexing: Multi-table MySQL schema with compound indexes across property type, geographical division, and project status for rapid sub-50ms queries.
Dynamic CMS Settings Engine: JSON-backed homepage statistics, hero image carousel control, and testimonial management operable via admin dashboard.
Kinetic Property Showcase: Hardware-accelerated Framer Motion transitions and lazy-loaded image carousels maintaining 60 FPS interaction across mobile devices.

work.d: Enterprise agency portal and headless management platform driving brand identity, service showcases, case studies, interactive project quotations, and secure administrative controls.

dossier.topology: [Client RFQ & Case Study Ingestion] -> [Rate-Limited Express API] -> [MySQL Connection Pool] -> [Next.js App Router Frontend]
dossier.challenge: Protecting agency lead generation and quotation forms from spam injection and brute-force abuse while ensuring instantaneous client portfolio browsing and zero downtime across international enterprise clients.
dossier.solution: Architected a hardened full-stack platform featuring Dual-Token JWT authentication (15m access / 7d refresh with automated rotation), rate-limiter-flexible API guarding, and connection-pooled MySQL data access with Next.js App Router client caching.
decisions: Enterprise Dual-Token Auth: Short-lived access tokens with HTTP-only secure cookie refresh token rotation and 12-round bcrypt password hashing.
DoS-Guarded Form Ingestion: Flexible in-memory rate limiting and Joi schema validation protecting quotation and contact inquiry endpoints.
Modular Portfolio Engine: Categorized project showcases with multi-image gallery uploads, technology tag associations, and responsive case study routing.

about.p: Five years engineering scalable cloud systems and reactive interfaces. Specialized in TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js and distributed backend pipelines.
Architecture first, then modular microservices, type-safe APIs, and 120 FPS creative experiences built for resilience and zero-downtime scale.
Building distributed systems for global SaaS, fintech and high-throughput cloud teams across the US, UK, and worldwide.

details.desc: Architected and deployed dynamic event-driven features, customized news pages, and high-performance server-side architectures for a high-traffic news platform serving thousands of daily active users.
dels: Architected and deployed dynamic event-driven features for a high-traffic news platform using Next.js and PostgreSQL, serving thousands of daily active users.
Optimized ad-delivery workflows by integrating Google Ads and 3rd-party scripts, resulting in improved layout stability and reduced Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
Enhanced system reliability by implementing PM2 process management and server monitoring, achieving 99.9% uptime for internal publishing tools.
Collaborated with SEO teams to implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR) strategies, increasing organic search visibility for feature sections by 15%.
Developed and maintained in-house full-stack web applications integrating React, Node.js, Express.js, Laravel, MySQL, and MongoDB.

details.desc: Engineered scalable e-commerce frontend architectures and responsive web platforms including PharmaSphere, implementing secure JWT authentication, state management, and reusable UI components.
dels: Developed a scalable e-commerce frontend architecture using React, TypeScript, and Redux, reducing state-related bugs by 40%.
Engineered reusable UI components with Tailwind CSS, accelerating development velocity for subsequent sprint cycles.
Integrated secure authentication flows (JWT) and complex filtering logic for product catalogs, improving user conversion rates.
Built PharmaSphere (MERN stack pharmacy platform) and a dynamic movie-listing web app with REST APIs and Context API.

details.desc: Programmed 2D and 3D game mechanics in C# for Android, creating custom shaders, particle systems, and visual effects optimized for smooth 60 FPS mobile performance.
dels: Programmed 2D/3D game mechanics in C# for Android, optimizing draw calls and memory usage for low-end mobile devices.
Designed custom shaders, particle systems, and textures using Visual Effect Graph, enhancing visual fidelity while maintaining consistent 60 FPS performance.
Collaborated within a multidisciplinary team of 6 engineers on mixed-reality games, simulations, and mobile applications.

details.desc: Served as an executive committee member managing operational budgeting, sponsorships, and technical event execution for university programming contests, webinars, and workshops.
dels: Maintained financial accounts, budget allocation, and fund logistics across a 2-year tenure for the university's central tech club.
Organized and managed flagship collegiate technical events including Programming Contests, 3-Minute Tech Presentations, Gaming Tournaments, and developer workshops.
Fostered technical growth, cross-functional team coordination, and student engagement across multiple university departments.

High-throughput RESTful, GraphQL, and WebSocket APIs in Node.js/TypeScript with auth/RBAC, microservice buses, and Stripe integration.
Normalized PostgreSQL relational schemas, Prisma/Drizzle ORM, ACID transactions, indexing strategies, and sub-millisecond Redis caching layers.
Deep audits, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, server-side payload compression, strict rate limiting, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerability protection.

process.d: System requirements, entity-relationship diagrams (ERD), API contract specifications, and tech stack validation.
PostgreSQL schema migrations, Prisma/Drizzle models, authentication/RBAC middleware, and core API routes.
Next.js App Router client-server integration, server actions, optimistic UI, state management, and real-time updates.
End-to-end integration testing, Core Web Vitals 100/100 tuning, OWASP security audit, and zero-downtime deployment.
